submitted.rationale: Mg–Sb–O phases such as MgSb2O6 (trirutile) and Mg-rich MgO/Mg-antimonates have wide band gaps (>3.5 eV), so they absorb very little at 2.1 eV. All five EQE measurements came out near zero (|EQE| < 0.002%), which is within noise. Index 22 (Sb 0.669, close to MgSb2O6 stoichiometry) gave the highest value at 0.00142%, so I am submitting it. The difference from the other points is probably not significant.
